'''Pelham Bay''' is a [[middle class]] residential [[neighborhood]] in the [[borough (New York City)|borough]] of [[the Bronx]], in [[New York City]]. It is named for [[Pelham Bay Park]], New York City's largest park, which lies on the neighborhood's northeastern border; and for [[Pelham Bay]], a body of water in that park. The neighborhood is bounded roughly by [[Pelham Parkway (road)|Pelham Parkway]] on the north, the [[New England Thruway]] ([[Interstate 95 in New York|I-95]]) on the east, the [[Bruckner Expressway]] (I-95) on the south, and the [[Hutchinson River Parkway]] on the west.

Pelham Bay is part of [[Bronx Community Board 10|Bronx Community District 10]], and its ZIP Code is 10461.<ref name="NYCPlanning"/> Pelham Bay is patrolled by the 45th Precinct of the [[New York City Police Department]].
